If I need tech support at 3 AM, what should I do?
Tech Support is available 24/7. You can call 1-800-555-0199 anytime, even at 3 AM, and someone will assist you.

How soon can I get a same-day urgent appointment at Acme Health?
Same-day urgent appointments are available at all Acme Health primary care offices, so you can get care quickly when you need it.

Can I see a specialist without a referral on all plans?

It depends on your plan. If you have Acme Health Plus HMO Bronze or Silver plans, you’ll need a referral to see a specialist. But Gold and Platinum plans let you see specialists directly without a referral.

How do I find a doctor who speaks my language and accepts new patients?
You can use the ACME Online provider directory to search for doctors by specialty, zip code, language spoken, and whether they’re accepting new patients.

On the Silver plan, a specialist visit costs you $50.

Yes, you can provide your ZIP code on file instead of your Member ID, along with your full legal name and date of birth, to verify your identity.

Refill requests submitted after 2:00 PM Pacific are filled the next business day.

Can I transfer my Schedule II controlled substance prescription to ACME?
No, Schedule II controlled substances cannot be transferred from another pharmacy. You'll need a new prescription from your provider to fill it at ACME.

To verify your identity, I need three things: your full legal name, your date of birth, and either your Member ID or the ZIP code we have on file for you.
